description: Defines an alert for a device that may require attention, optionally associated with the animal the device is linked to.

alertEndDateTime.description: RFC3339 date time that represents the end time of an alert (start time is the eventDateTime) if it has ended.

category.description: A category that allows filtering of alerts by subject. Typically DeviceIssue or Environment for device alerts.

causes.description: The specific causes of the alert. This is an array and at least one cause must be specified.

priority.description: The relative priority of the alert.

animal.description: Optionally, the animal the device is linked to at the time of the alert.
